summary.text: Taffy Howard is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 34 who took office on January 14, 2025, after serving in the state House from 2017 to 2023.
A business owner and U.S. Air Force veteran, she advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Howard earned a high school diploma from Lincoln High School and a bachelor's degree in mathematics from South Dakota State University in 1989.
She served as an officer in the U.S. Air Force from 1990 to 1994, and her career experience includes working as a business owner.
Before the Senate, Howard represented District 33 in the South Dakota House of Representatives, where she was vice chair of the House Appropriations Committee in 2021-2022.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she ran for Congress in 2022 and received 41% of the vote in the Republican primary.
In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Senate Government Operations and Audit Committee and serves on the Senate Appropriations and Military and Veterans' Affairs committees.
In the 2024 survey, she named rising property taxes, education, and crime and homelessness as top concerns, and described herself as a conservative Republican who believes in limited government.
